analysis.title: Merck & Co. (MRK): 3Q26 First Take — Beat and Raise Amidst Lowered Expectations
key_insights: MRK reported 3Q26 total revenue of $18,085mn, about 4.5% above GS/Visible Alpha consensus of $17,308mn, against lowered expectations for the print.
FY26 revenue guidance was raised from $66.3bn-$67.3bn to $66.8bn-$67.3bn, and EPS guidance from $2.66-$2.76 to $2.77-$2.82.

Gardasil CDC purchases of about $550mn were a one-time item that largely drove the guidance raise. Gardasil sales were $1,995mn vs GS $1,169mn and consensus $1,130mn, on higher US sales from favorable public-sector purchasing patterns and higher net pricing.

Key products for the forward narrative beat: Winrevair $694mn vs consensus $647mn, Keytruda Qlex $830mn vs consensus $720mn, Ohtuvayre $184mn vs consensus $180mn. Capvaxive missed at $263mn vs consensus $319mn.
Adjusted EPS including IPR&D was $2.49 vs GS and consensus of $2.08, about 19.6% above consensus. Adjusted EBIT ex-IPR&D was $7,314mn vs consensus $6,866mn.
On 2027, the key debate going into the print, the company expects underlying operating expenses to rise mid- to high-single digits, in line with the GS model and prior investor conference messaging.

GS sees the result as a positive surprise given positioning. MRK shares underperformed despite a strong ESMO showing, and investors were fading the name ahead of results because of softer 2027 earnings from higher OpEx.

With the 2027 OpEx dynamic now widely understood and reflected in the stock, post-earnings trajectory depends on confidence in the clinical catalyst path (INT RCC, TroFuse interims), where management framing matters.

GS listed four items to watch on the 9am ET call: a preliminary 2027 outlook, framing on clinical catalysts and full data disclosures (tulisokibart, MK-3000, MK-1406/CD388, intismeran, sac-TMT), metrics on launches (Lipfendra, Winrevair, Ohtuvayre), and updated BD messaging.
GS rates MRK Buy with a 12m price target of $155 (16x P/E on Q5-Q8 adjusted EPS), vs a $140.93 price, implying 10.0% upside.

market_movers.rationale: 3Q26 beat and FY26 guidance raise against lowered expectations. 12m PT based on 16x P/E on Q5-Q8 adjusted EPS, 10.0% upside from $140.93.

earnings_insights: MRK 3Q26 reported 10/29: total revenue $18,085mn vs GS est $17,288mn and Visible Alpha consensus est $17,308mn (+4.6% vs GS, +4.5% vs consensus).
MRK 3Q26 reported 10/29: adj. EPS incl. IPR&D $2.49 vs GS est $2.08 and consensus est $2.08.
MRK 3Q26 reported: adj. EBIT ex-IPR&D $7,314mn vs GS est $6,863mn and consensus est $6,866mn. Gross margin 81.4% vs consensus est 80.8%.
MRK 3Q26 reported: R&D $4,553mn vs consensus est $4,259mn (25.2% of revenue vs 24.6% est). SG&A $2,862mn vs consensus est $2,860mn.
MRK FY26 guidance raised: revenue from $66.3bn-$67.3bn to $66.8bn-$67.3bn, EPS from $2.66-$2.76 to $2.77-$2.82. Approx $550mn of Gardasil CDC purchases was one-time and largely drove the raise.

MRK 3Q26 reported products: Keytruda IV + SubQ $8,601mn vs consensus est $8,362mn. Keytruda IV $7,771mn vs est $7,642mn. Welireg $307mn vs est $286mn. Januvia $367mn vs est $156mn. Janumet $207mn vs est $131mn.
MRK 3Q26 reported animal health: Livestock $1,048mn vs consensus est $1,070mn. Companion Animal $628mn vs est $624mn.
GS estimates: 9/26E EPS $2.08, 12/26E EPS $1.95, 3/27E EPS $2.14. FY26E EPS $2.61, FY27E $8.76, FY28E $10.23. 2027 underlying OpEx expected to grow mid- to high-single digits.
risk_factors: Faster-than-expected erosion of Keytruda loss of exclusivity, or lower-than-expected conversion to SubQ Keytruda.
Further slowdown in established vaccine products, slower ramp of newly launched products, and regulatory uncertainty.
Tougher regulatory and market environment for vaccines, FDA, tariffs, and M&A.
Part of the beat came from one-time Gardasil CDC purchases rather than recurring demand.
vol_and_positioning: Investors were fading MRK ahead of 3Q26 results because of messaging on softer 2027 earnings from OpEx, per GS conversations. MRK shares underperformed despite a strong ESMO showing.

tension_points.bull_case: Beat and raise against lowered expectations, with Winrevair, Keytruda Qlex and Ohtuvayre ahead of consensus, and the 2027 OpEx headwind now widely understood and reflected in the stock.
tension_points.bear_case: The guidance raise was largely driven by one-time Gardasil CDC purchases of about $550mn, Capvaxive missed, and 2027 underlying OpEx is set to rise mid- to high-single digits.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Weak management framing on the clinical catalyst path (INT RCC, TroFuse interims) on the 9am ET call.
